entries.title: Proverbs 19:1
segments: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: The foolishness of man subverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:4
segments: Wealth addeth many friends; But the poor is separated from his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:5
segments: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall not escape.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:6
segments: Many will entreat the favor of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: How much more do his friends go far from him! He pursueth [them with] words, [but] they are gone.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:8
segments: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: He that keepeth understanding shall find good.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:9
segments: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: Delicate living is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:11
segments: The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:12
segments: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favor is as dew upon the grass.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:14
segments: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; [But] he that is careless of his ways shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:17
segments: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Jehovah, And his good deed will he pay him again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope;  nd set not thy heart on his destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: A man of great wrath shall bear the penalty; For if thou deliver [him], thou must do it yet again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:20
segments: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:21
segments: There are many devices in a man's heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: That which maketh a man to be desired is his kindness; And a poor man is better than a liar.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: The fear of Jehovah [tendeth] to life; And he [that hath it] shall abide satisfied; He shall not be visited with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: Smite a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; And reprove one that hath understanding, [and] he will understand knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: He that doeth violence to his father, and chaseth away his mother, Is a son that causeth shame and bringeth reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:27
segments: Cease, my son, to hear instruction [Only] to err from the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: A worthless witness mocketh at justice; And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And stripes for the back of fools.
